create_ir_csn_152: create an inverted residual CSN-152 video recognition model with randomly initialized weights
create_ip_csn_152: create an inverted parallel CSN-152 video recognition model with randomly initialized weights
build_ir_csn_152_pretrained: build an inverted residual CSN-152 model pretrained on ig65m with 32 frames
build_ip_csn_152_pretrained: build an inverted parallel CSN-152 model pretrained on kinetics with 32 frames
configure_ir_csn_152_pooling: configure an inverted residual CSN-152 model with disabled pool1 stem for standard convolution
